page.overview:
What is Mini Mini no Mi?

The Mini Mini no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to become smaller than their actual size. The fruit was eaten by two different characters under different media: Blyue in the video game One Piece: Round the Land and Lily Enstomach in the Z's Ambition Arc.

The main strength of this Devil Fruit is that the user can shrink down to 5 mm in height without reducing their strength. The user can also return to their original dimensions or any new size between the two extremes. The fruit also seems to affect clothes and personal items such as weapons, which changes size to match the users, as seen when Blyue's battle axe and shield and Lily's fork grow larger when they turn into their normal giant forms. However, this trait does not seem to be unique to the Mini Mini fruit in particular.

As a drawback, this fruit permanently changes the default size of its user, which becomes about the height of two human hands. This means that if the fruit's powers are negated, such as when falling in the sea, the user's size will change back to this new form rather than their original. Also, while the power does not affect the strength of the user, it also does not seem to affect their appetite, as they must still intake the usual amount of food that they would in their original form. In addition, if the user becomes overly excited, then some parts of the body will become disproportionate from the others, as shown when Lily's head became bigger than her body after remembering that she had to rescue her father from the Marines. Other than this, the fruit also has the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

For giants like Blyue and Lily, they are capable of shrinking down to a smaller size, making it easier for them to interact with humans and smaller creatures, as well as gain mobility in terms of avoiding attacks. Furthermore, the shrinking power makes the user far more stealthy and harder to find. Another effect that is especially convenient for people who enjoy to eat, is that the food will be large compared to the user, giving them more food to eat.
